acceptanceCovered: every endpoint in api-spec section 3 in phase-04 scope behaves per spec
invalid state transitions always return 409 and are never silently ignored
end succeeds only when seqs 1..last_seq are persisted, otherwise 409 SEGMENTS_PENDING naming missing seqs
deleting a meeting removes all child rows while entities still mentioned elsewhere survive
meetings abandoned for 24 hours are auto-closed and still queued for processing
sending the same seq 10 times produces exactly one row
reconnect and resend loses no segment and duplicates none
segment_ack is only emitted after the row is in PostgreSQL, proven by fault injection
load test keeps p95 ack latency under 500ms
regressionChecked: global JwtAuthGuard now skips non-HTTP contexts
existing auth/users endpoints and account-maintenance jobs
ApiExceptionFilter change applies to every endpoint, not only the bulk-segments path
end() reorder does not skip flushing buffered WebSocket segments before the last_seq check
idx_meetings_status migration up/down/up symmetry and entity @Index metadata match

findings.summary: fixed: non-HttpException errors now always return a fixed INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE to the client; the real message/stack only goes to the server log. Root-caused at the global filter, covers every endpoint including the bulk-segments path. Verified against api-exception.filter.spec.ts (fixed-message case + new raw-pg-constraint-text case).

fixed: end() now flushes and runs findMissingSeqs before opening the transaction, so the row lock is only held for the transition re-validation; segment-upsert.repository.ts:76-96 adds a fast indexed count(*) path and only falls back to generate_series when something is actually missing. Correctness (missing-set is monotonic while a meeting is live) verified by inspection and by the new end-flushes-batch-writer.e2e.spec.ts.

fixed: idx_meetings_status recreated to include 'paused' in its partial predicate, matching closeAbandonedMeetings()'s IN ('recording','paused') filter; entity @Index where-clause updated to match; up/down verified symmetric.
TranscriptSegmentPayload dropped speaker_label -- a breaking WS wire-contract change, documented as intentional (US-13 dropped) in clarifications.md. Tracked as CHANGED, not treated as a defect.
requeueStrandedMeetings filters status='queued' AND updated_at < cutoff with no supporting index on updated_at; deferred by agreement given tiny queued cardinality and the existing status filter.
